en: This postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate building behind a prominent fountain with multiple streams of water. The structure appears to be a grand 19th-century style building. The postcard contains decorative borders and is split between the image and handwritten message space. At the top right, the postcard says 'Sundsvall.' The bottom left of the image area is labeled 'Vängåfvan.' The publisher is indicated as 'W. Ahlströms Bokhandel, Sundsvall' along the left edge. The back shows address fields, a Swedish stamp, and more Swedish writing.
